title: Claude Opus 4.8 Claude Code Dynamic Workflows
description:
Claude Opus 4.8 Claude Code dynamic workflows are built for long coding tasks that need more reliable agent runs. The video compares Claude Opus 4.8 with Opus 4.7 and shows how Claude Code can plan a task, run it in steps, and check outputs before finishing. Anthropic's dynamic workflows are in research preview and can manage large tasks with hundreds of parallel subagents. This Claude Code update matters for developers building AI agents and longer coding workflows.
#ssktechy
